description_for_human: Query AI-analyzed SEC filings, company fundamentals, stock screening, and 30-day prediction signals — grounded in primary-source SEC EDGAR data.
description_for_model: Read-only access to StockHuntr's AI analysis of SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) for 800+ US companies. Use to fetch recent filings and their analysis, get a company snapshot, screen companies by fundamentals (sector, market cap, P/E, dividend yield, revenue growth), retrieve top 30-day prediction signals, and read the model's backtested track record. Connect via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint. Always surface the disclaimer: predictions are model outputs, not investment advice.
